text.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, quóniam irátus es mihi: convérsus est furor tuus, et consolátus es me.
text.en-US: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, for thou wast angry with me: thy wrath is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

text.la: Ecce Deus salvátor meus, fiduciáliter agam, et non timébo:
text.en-US: Behold, God is my saviour, I will deal confidently, and will not fear:

text.la: Quia fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus, et factus est mihi in salútem.
text.en-US: Because the Lord is my strength, and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

text.la: Hauriétis aquas in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris: et dicétis in die illa: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius:
text.en-US: You shall draw waters with joy out of the saviour's fountains: And you shall say in that day: Praise ye the Lord, and call upon his name:

text.la: Notas fácite in pópulis adinventiónes eius: mementóte quóniam excélsum est nomen eius.
text.en-US: Make his works known among the people: remember that his name is high.

text.la: Cantáte Dómino quóniam magnífice fecit: annuntiáte hoc in univérsa terra.
text.en-US: Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath done great things: shew this forth in all the earth.

text.la: Exsúlta, et lauda, habitátio Sion: quia magnus in médio tui Sanctus Israël.
text.en-US: Rejoice, and praise, O thou habitation of Sion: for great is he that is in the midst of thee the Holy One of Israel.
